description: Learn skid-steer speed/turning response on example 03's MuJoCo vehicle and four ANCF tires, using 07's physical settings. Compare before/after motion to a gray target vehicle.

arg_help.target-speed: Requested forward speed [m/s], 0.2–0.9; changing it replays before/after using the fitted response.
arg_help.target-yaw-deg: Requested yaw rate [degrees/s], -3 to 3; positive turns left.
arg_help.train: Collect straight and gentle/strong left/right maneuvers, fit with Warp gradients, then test the learned commands. False runs only the initial comparison until Learn again is pressed.
arg_help.telemetry-config: Source vehicle_telemetry JSON; null uses 07_vehicle_telemetry.json. Physical vehicle/tire settings are reused on flat ground.
arg_help.report: Optional new .json report and sibling observation .csv. These synthetic response fits do not overwrite or recalibrate the source 07 preset.
